title: Deduhonghua-7 powder and its bioactive component luteolin alleviate hepatic fibrosis through CHRM3/NF-kappaB axis.
authors: Yumei; Anda; Xue, Runguo; HaSi; Bai, Tana; Bai, Yingchun; Han, Zhiqiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药粉末及木犀草素通过CHRM3/NF-kappaB轴缓解肝纤维化，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: To examine the hepatoprotective and antifibrotic properties of Deduhonghua-7 powder and its active component luteolin in a CCl(4)-induced liver fibrosis model, followed by in-depth analysis of the associated molecular mechanisms. METHODS: A CCl(4)-induced chronic hepatic injury mouse model was constructed to evaluate the therapeutic efficacy of Deduhonghua-7 powder. Potential targets and active components were predicted through network pharmacology and molecular docking, followed by molecular dynamics simulations to verify the binding stability of luteolin to key targets. The antifibrotic mechanism of luteolin was further investigated in CCl(4)-stimulated LX2 human hepatic stellate cells and CHRM3-overexpression models. RESULTS: Deduhonghua-7 powder significantly ameliorated CCl(4)-induced hepatic histopathological damage, reduced collagen deposition, and normalized serum ALT, AST, and ALP levels. Network pharmacology analysis identified 30 therapeutic targets and revealed multi-component, multi-target mechanisms. Molecular docking and dynamics studies consistently showed stable binding interactions between luteolin and core targets CHRM3 and STAT3, with binding free energies reaching </=-13.39 kcal/mol. Notably, luteolin treatment markedly restored CHRM3 expression that was suppressed by CCl(4) both in vivo and in vitro. Either CHRM3 activation via oxotremorine-M or CHRM3 overexpression significantly inhibited CCl(4)-induced upregulation of alpha-SMA and COL1A1, mimicking the antifibrotic effects of luteolin. Furthermore, luteolin-mediated CHRM3 restoration contributed to reduced hepatic inflammation, characterized by lower levels of IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha, and attenuated NF-kappaB p65 phosphorylation. CONCLUSION: Deduhonghua-7 powder exerts potent antifibrotic effects against CCl(4)-induced liver injury. Luteolin, a key active component, attenuates hepatic fibrosis and inflammation by upregulating CHRM3 expression, thereby inhibiting hepatic stellate cell activation and NF-kappaB signaling.
abstract_zh: 背景：探讨德都红花-7散及其活性成分木犀草素在CCl(4)诱导的肝纤维化模型中的保肝和抗纤维化作用，并深入分析相关分子机制。方法：构建CCl(4)诱导的慢性肝损伤小鼠模型，评估德都红花-7散的治疗效果。通过网络药理学和分子对接预测潜在靶点和活性成分，随后进行分子动力学模拟以验证木犀草素与关键靶点的结合稳定性。在CCl(4)刺激的LX2人肝星状细胞和CHRM3过表达模型中进一步研究木犀草素的抗纤维化机制。结果：德都红花-7散显著改善CCl(4)诱导的肝脏组织病理损伤，减少胶原沉积，并恢复血清ALT、AST和ALP水平。网络药理学分析识别出30个治疗靶点，揭示多成分、多靶点机制。分子对接和动力学研究一致显示木犀草素与核心靶点CHRM3和STAT3之间存在稳定结合相互作用，结合自由能达到≤-13.39 kcal/mol。值得注意的是，木犀草素处理显著恢复CCl(4)在体内和体外抑制的CHRM3表达。通过oxotremorine-M激活CHRM3或CHRM3过表达均显著抑制CCl(4)诱导的alpha-SMA和COL1A1上调，模拟木犀草素的抗纤维化效果。此外，木犀草素介导的CHRM3恢复有助于减少肝脏炎症，表现为IL-1beta、IL-6和TNF-alpha水平降低，并减弱NF-kappaB p65磷酸化。结论：德都红花-7散对CCl(4)诱导的肝损伤发挥强效抗纤维化作用。木犀草素作为关键活性成分，通过上调CHRM3表达，抑制肝星状细胞活化和NF-kappaB信号通路，从而减轻肝纤维化和炎症。
